prompt:
You are a senior financial analyst on the retail coverage team. Your group director has asked you to prepare a variance analysis and profitability dashboard for Home Depot (HD) covering the latest full fiscal year (FY 2025) versus the prior fiscal year (FY 2024). The analysis will be used in an upcoming investment committee meeting to evaluate whether HD's margin performance justifies a continued overweight position.

Materials provided:
- The attached XBRL financial data extract for The Home Depot, Inc. (CIK 0000354950, ticker HD, sector: retail) containing quarterly and annual financial metrics extracted from SEC filings, including RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, GrossProfit, OperatingIncomeLoss, NetIncomeLoss, SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense, EarningsPerShareDiluted, Assets, Liabilities, StockholdersEquity, and CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue for FY 2024, FY 2025, and interim quarters Q1 through Q3 of FY 2025.

Task requirements:
1. Build an Excel workbook with three tabs: 'Inputs', 'Variance Analysis', and 'Outputs'.
2. In the 'Inputs' tab, enter all raw financial figures from the XBRL data for FY 2024 and FY 2025 full years, plus quarterly data for FY 2025 (Q1, Q2, Q3). Use columns for each period and rows for each line item: Revenue, Gross Profit, Operating Income, Net Income, SG&A Expense, and EPS Diluted.
3. In the 'Variance Analysis' tab, calculate the following for FY 2025 full-year figures versus FY 2024:
   - Revenue variance in absolute dollars and as a percentage change
   - Gross Profit variance in absolute dollars and as a percentage change
   - Gross Margin percentage for each year (Gross Profit / Revenue) and the year-over-year variance expressed in basis points
   - Operating Income variance in absolute dollars and as a percentage change
   - Operating Margin percentage for each year (Operating Income / Revenue) and the year-over-year variance expressed in basis points
   - Net Income variance in absolute dollars and as a percentage change
   - Net Margin percentage for each year (Net Income / Revenue) and the year-over-year variance expressed in basis points
   - SG&A as a percentage of revenue for each year and the year-over-year variance expressed in basis points
   - EPS Diluted variance in absolute dollars and as a percentage change
4. In the 'Outputs' tab, create a summary dashboard table with one row per metric (Revenue Growth, Gross Margin Δ bps, Operating Margin Δ bps, Net Margin Δ bps, SG&A Ratio Δ bps, EPS Growth) showing the FY 2025 value and the variance versus FY 2024.
5. All percentage calculations must be formatted with two decimal places. Margin calculations must use the formula line item divided by revenue. Basis point variances must equal the difference in percentage points multiplied by 100.
6. Use the FY 2025 full-year revenue of $164,683,000,000 as the denominator for FY 2025 margin calculations and the FY 2024 full-year revenue of $96,119,000,000 for FY 2024 margins.

Deliverable specification:
- Submit a single Excel workbook (.xlsx) with three tabs named exactly 'Inputs', 'Variance Analysis', and 'Outputs'.
- All cells with input data should have a light blue fill. All calculated cells should have a light yellow fill.
- Column widths should accommodate the data without truncation.
- Include a header row in each tab with bold formatting.
